clips.app: Begin by opening Northstar Planning. Its U X pages provide the source for your formatted report.
clips.category: Open Budget Owner Review to locate the report page.
clips.discover: Choose Discover modules. This identifies the grids and underlying modules on the page.
clips.grid: Select the Budget Review grid. It combines financial results with owner commentary.
clips.export: Choose Export selected grid to review the report's rows, columns, and shared filters.
clips.rows: Select the row dimension to explore the account hierarchy. You can also keep the default selections and create the pivot.
clips.hierarchy: Open Hierarchy Selectors to select a complete level. You can also choose individual accounts below.
clips.create: Review your selections, then choose Create Pivot. Time and Executive Owner apply to both module regions.
clips.done: Your sample report is ready. Select Done to review the formatted sheet.
clips.complete: The report preserves source formatting, hierarchy totals, and shared filters. Use Repivot to adjust selections, or Refresh to reload the sample.
clips.search: No page matches this search. Clear or change the search text to continue.
clips.selection: Select at least one row and one line item before creating your report.
clips.name: Enter a valid sheet name, then choose Create Pivot again. The message on screen identifies the required correction.
